findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "twitter-x-aio" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_search_searchTerm, get_tweet_tweetId, get_resolve_urls, post_search_searchTerm, post_tweet_tweetId · Public sink: get_search_searchTerm, get_tweet_tweetId, get_tweet_tweetId_favorites, get_tweet_tweetId_retweets, post_search_searchTerm, post_tweet_tweetId.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_search_searchTerm, get_tweet_tweetId, get_resolve_urls, post_search_searchTerm, post_tweet_tweetId · Public sink: get_search_searchTerm, get_tweet_tweetId, get_tweet_tweetId_favorites, get_tweet_tweetId_retweets, post_search_searchTerm, post_tweet_tweetId

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
